title: Understanding Linear Separability
text: When a dataset is linearly separable, it means that there exists a straight line (or hyperplane in higher dimensions) that can perfectly separate the classes in the dataset. This is a key concept in understanding why a logistic regression model might achieve 100% accuracy.

title: Logistic Regression and Linear Separability
text: Logistic regression is a linear model, which means it tries to find a linear boundary to separate different classes. If the data is linearly separable, logistic regression can achieve perfect accuracy.
